title: 第22章 第二道本源第23章 酸液飞溅
slug: 法师之上第366章五环法师
content_zh:
皮埃尔点点头。
“老板你刚刚不是还说在霍根城内找不到活的地脉生物吗？这不就是吗。”得到了肯定的答案，高德心中喜悦。
“这也算？”皮埃尔难以理解。
在他认知中，高德想要“购买”的地脉生物，要么是可以作为食材的地脉生物，要么是可以作为宠物的地脉生物。
这种生活在下水道的蠕虫怎么能算呢？
地脉生物十分危险，但都被隔绝在了城市之外，并且还会有法师定期在城市周边巡逻与清理，确保轻易不会有地脉生物接近人类聚居地。
所以一般情况下，城市中是不会出现地脉生物的，有出现也基本是被控制的。
唯有灰眼鼠这种对人类毫无威胁的地脉生物是例外。
它们虽然具备地脉生物血脉，但因为不具备威胁，所以在人类眼中和普通的动物并无差别。
暗沼潜蠕也是此类型的地脉生物。
当然，这种类型的地脉生物是极少极少的，大多数地脉生物都是极其危险的。
这怎么不算呢........
高德在心中暗道，当然嘴上肯定不会这样说。
“既然这种蠕虫善于隐藏，你们一般怎么清理？”
“要么使用大量烧开的热水对下水道进行冲洗，驱赶和清除部分蠕虫。”
“要么就是使用杀虫药水，稀释后注入下水道来杀死这些暗沼潜蠕。”皮埃尔摊了摊手道。
“只是这些暗沼潜蠕，因为是地脉生物，生命力都极为顽强，用热水冲洗法驱赶清除的话，往往需要大量的时间，所以一般情况下都是使用杀虫药水进行清理。”
“杀虫药水很昂贵？”高德抓住关键。
“那倒也不是，”皮埃尔摇摇头，“不过是用来清理蠕虫的药水，能有多贵？价格高点可就没人买了，大不了多花点时间。”
“那是？”高德看出皮埃尔对于这项工作很困扰。

“主要是下水道那地方臭气熏天且阴暗潮湿，谁乐意去........”皮埃尔无奈道。
高德恍然大悟。
能在商业区拿下一间门店做生意的，怎么都算是有些身家，平日里也勉强算是“养尊处优”。
突然让这样的人要去下水道那种“肮脏之地”清理蠕虫，肯定是心里膈应的。
那些大一点的店面还好，可以把这活交给店员们。
皮埃尔就惨了，他的杂货店除了他这个店长，根本没有店员。
而且城卫兵又是临时通知，过两天就是交易日，时间这么赶，他根本来不及去雇一个临时工，只能是自己亲自动手了。
“2枚三叶花银币，杀虫药水你出，我帮你清理暗沼潜蠕。”高德一开口就是出乎皮埃尔预料。
“这种钱你都有兴趣赚？”他忍不住诧异道。
“为何不呢？”高德一摊手，问道：“难道你不乐意出这个钱？”
2枚三叶花银币，清理暗沼潜蠕，说实话这个价格是偏高了。
content_en:
Pierre nodded.
"Boss, didn't you just say that no living earth-line creatures can be found in Hogan City? Isn't that true." After getting the affirmative answer, Gothe felt happy.
"Does this count?" Pierre couldn't understand.
In his understanding, the leyline creatures that Gothe wants to "purchase" are either leyline creatures that can be used as food, or leyline creatures that can be used as pets.
How could this worm that lives in sewers be counted?
Leyline creatures are very dangerous, but they are isolated from the city, and mages will regularly patrol and clean up around the city to ensure that no leyline creatures will easily approach human settlements.
Therefore, under normal circumstances, leyline creatures will not appear in cities, and if they do appear, they are basically controlled.
The only exception is the gray-eyed rat, a leyline creature that poses no threat to humans.
Although they have the blood of earth-line creatures, they are no different from ordinary animals in the eyes of humans because they do not pose a threat.
Darkmarsh creepers are also this type of leyline creature.
Of course, this type of leyline creatures are very rare, and most leyline creatures are extremely dangerous.
Why doesn't this count?......
Gothe secretly thought in his heart, of course he would never say this.
"Since this worm is good at hiding, how do you usually clean it up?"
"Either use large amounts of boiling hot water to flush the sewers to drive away and remove some of the worms."
"Either use insecticide, dilute it and inject it into the sewer to kill these dark swamp crawlers." Pierre spread his hands and said.
"It's just that these dark swamp crawlers are extremely tenacious because they are earth-vein creatures. It often takes a lot of time to drive them away with hot water flushing. Therefore, insecticides are usually used to clean them."
"Insecticides are expensive?" Gaode grasped the key point.
"That's not the case," Pierre shook his head. "It's just a potion used to clean up worms. How expensive can it be? If the price is higher, no one will buy it. It will cost you more time."
"That is?" Gothe saw that Pierre was troubled by this work.
"The main reason is that the sewer is smelly, dark and damp. Who would be willing to go there..." Pierre said helplessly.
Gothe suddenly realized.
Anyone who can open a store in a business district is considered to be somewhat wealthy, and can barely be regarded as "pampered" on weekdays.
It must be very disturbing to suddenly ask such a person to go to a "dirty place" like a sewer to clean up worms.
Those larger stores are okay and can leave this job to the clerks.
Pierre is miserable. His grocery store has no clerk at all except for him as the store manager.
Moreover, the city guard gave a short notice, and the trading day would be in two days. The time was so tight that he had no time to hire a temporary worker, so he had to do it himself.
"Two silver clover coins, you provide the insecticide, and I will help you clean up the dark swamp crawlers." Gothe's words were beyond Pierre's expectations.
"Are you interested in making this kind of money?" He couldn't help but asked in surprise.
"Why not?" Gothe spread his hands and asked, "Aren't you willing to pay for it?"
2 silver clover coins to clean up the Dark Swamp Stalkers. To be honest, the price is on the high side.
